expected_outcome: Reject (v1 hand review): The list already runs seven repeatable sacrifice outlets (Altar of Dementia, Ashnod's Altar, Phyrexian Altar, Carrion Feeder, Goblin Bombardment, Warren Soultrader, Yawgmoth) plus Skullclamp. A one-shot outlet adds little. Reanimate is the deck's cheapest recursion: it returns a sacrificed threat or an opponent's best creature lost to Thraximundar's edict, and it is protected now.
